### 🧪 NetSpeedTray 2.2.1-beta.2

The second beta of 2.2.1. Thanks to everyone who tested beta.1 - especially @evandrosergiooliveira-cloud (0.5 s) and @bobbergen (Remote Desktop).

**Betas don't update in-app, and WinGet and the Store won't offer this one.** Download Setup.exe or the portable zip below and install over 2.2.0 or beta.1 as usual. Your history and settings carry over.

### What's new since beta.1

- **Honest connection drops in the Monitor.** Short drops used to get averaged away, so the Overview could say "steady" through a real outage. Now a drop needs about 6 seconds of lost pings (single blips don't count), an older drop shows its date, and red means "in the last 24 hours".
- **A much lighter Monitor.** The Overview used up to 17% of a CPU core while it was open - now under 1%. Its small graphs also span the whole range: "24 hours" was really showing the last 2 hours. Gaps (a sleeping laptop) now show as gaps.
- **"<0.1" instead of "0.0"** for light traffic with "Always show megabytes" on. Thanks @Buuuush (#556).
- **License texts ship with the app:** LICENSE.txt and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt now sit next to NetSpeedTray.exe.

### What I'd love you to test

- **The Overview's connection line:** if your connection drops (or you pull the cable for ~10 seconds), does it count it, with the right time?
- **The Overview's small graphs** on 24 Hours and Week: do they look right, including gaps while the PC slept?
- Everything from beta.1 still applies.

### What's next

2.2.1 final, after this beta has been tested and translators have had at least a week. No new strings in this beta.

Found something? Open a new issue, or comment on #576, with a support bundle (Export support bundle at the bottom of Settings). Usernames, paths and IPs are stripped from it.

Full changelog: https://github.com/erez-c137/NetSpeedTray/blob/main/changelog.md
